scientific_integrity: The origin of the prime product and prior finite observations are attributed. Integer-arithmetic certificate and its complete source are provided; no formal or independent verification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Exact squarefree index classification is restricted to nonnegative indices below \(2^{16384}\). No claim that 1055 is the global last squarefree index. Global finiteness follows from the prior Senge--Straus theorem and is not claimed as original.
title: Squarefree prime-product factorial quotients through \(2^{16384}\)
